editor.title: Edit service

readOnly.pending_review: This service is in review, so it can't be edited right now.
readOnly.suspended: This service is suspended and can't be edited.
readOnly.archived: This service is archived. Restore it to edit it again.

editor.liveEditNote: This service is live. Changes are visible straight away and are re-checked by Greco.
editor.pendingEditNote: Greco is re-checking your latest changes.

sections.basicsDescription: What you offer and where clients find it.
sections.pricingDescription: How the service is priced and how long it takes.
sections.packagesDescription: Up to three tiers, for example Basic, Standard and Premium.
sections.paymentDescription: When the client pays. Terms are locked once an order is accepted.
sections.deliverablesDescription: The concrete things the client receives.
sections.addonsDescription: Optional extras clients can add to an order.
sections.requirementsDescription: What you need from the client to start. They answer when ordering.
sections.faqsDescription: Answers to questions clients often ask.
sections.imagesDescription: Up to 8 images. The first one is the cover. JPG, PNG or WebP, up to 4 MB.

fields.title: Title
fields.titleHint: At least 15 characters. Say what the client gets, for example "AI receptionist that answers and books calls".
fields.slugHint: Part of the page address. Lowercase letters, numbers and hyphens.
fields.descriptionHint: At least 200 characters. The problem you solve, your approach, and what the client needs to provide. No contact details.
fields.termsHint: Up to 15. They help clients and AI Discovery find this service.
fields.quoteFromHint: Optional guide price. The final price is agreed in a custom offer.
fields.revisionPolicyHint: What counts as a revision and what doesn't.
fields.optionsHint: One per line, at least 2. Only for choice questions.
fields.question: Question
fields.altHint: Describes the image for people who can't see it.

packages.title: Packages
packages.description: Up to three tiers with their own price and delivery time.

fixed.title: Fixed price
fixed.description: One price for a clearly defined scope.

hourly.title: Hourly
hourly.description: An hourly rate with a minimum number of hours.

quote.title: Custom quote
quote.description: Clients describe their project and you send an offer.

full.title: Full payment upfront
full.description: The client pays the whole order before you start.

deposit.title: Deposit, then balance
deposit.description: The client pays a deposit before you start and the rest later.

balanceTriggers.on_milestone_acceptance: When the client accepts the first milestone
balanceTriggers.before_final_delivery: Before you send the final delivery

payment.rules: Minimum order: {minOrder}. Deposits are available on orders of {depositMin} or more.
payment.depositExample: On a {total} order the client pays {deposit} before you start and {balance} later.
payment.earningsExample: From a {total} payment you receive {earnings}. Greco's commission is {commission} ({rate}); clients pay no fee.
payment.noPriceYet: Set a price to see what the client pays and what you receive.
payment.noPayments: Payments aren't live yet. These terms apply once ordering opens.

checklist.title: Before you submit
checklist.title_item: Use a title of at least 15 characters
checklist.summary: Write a summary of at least 40 characters
checklist.description: Write a description of at least 200 characters
checklist.skills: Choose at least one skill or technology
checklist.pricing: Complete the pricing (price, and delivery time where needed)
checklist.min_order: Raise the price to at least the minimum order value
checklist.deposit: Choose one of the allowed deposit percentages
checklist.deposit_min_order: Deposits need a higher order value, or switch to full payment

lifecycle.submitHint: Greco checks every new service before it goes live.
lifecycle.pauseHint: Hide this service from clients for now.
lifecycle.deleteConfirm: Delete this draft service? This can't be undone.

new.title: Create a service
new.intro: Start with a title and a category. You can complete the rest before submitting.
